verdict.rationale: Sift documents its own Review Queues alongside Workflows, and the sandbox docs confirm Queues are part of the console. The Decisions API records the actions the business takes, such as approving or blocking an order, which gives a thin basis for a decision record. However, none of the team-workflow mechanics in the story are evidenced. Missing for 10: reviewer assignment, escalation paths, SLAs or queue timers, an audit trail showing who approved what and why, and any hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, review work is a team workflow — assignment, escalation, SLAs, and a decision audit trail that shows who approved what and why

citations.quote: Sift offers Workflows, a powerful rules automation platform, and Review Queues.
Selecting sandbox mode will switch you to the sandbox view so you can see all your test data in the console (e.g. Explore, Queues, Workflows, etc.).

What actions your business is taking in response to users (e.g., approve an order, block and event due to fraud, cancel order due to chargeback, etc). You will also send this data from your application to Sift via our Decisions API.
